scripts.wasm:build: cargo build -p wasm --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir public/wasm --out-name wasm $CARGO_TARGET_DIR/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/wasm.wasm
scripts.grammar:build: mkdir -p public/tree-sitter && tree-sitter build --wasm ../../packages/tree-sitter-into --output public/tree-sitter/into.wasm && cp ../../packages/tree-sitter-into/queries/highlights.scm node_modules/web-tree-sitter/web-tree-sitter.wasm public/tree-sitter/
scripts.vercel:install: curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf -L https://install.determinate.systems/nix | sh -s -- install linux --init none --no-confirm && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm nix:restore
scripts.vercel:build: PATH=/nix/var/nix/profiles/default/bin:$PATH nix develop ../..#playground -c pnpm build && pnpm nix:save
